hints.title: Partner and Ranking Tables
hints.text: Record the assigned partner pair_of[x] for each friend x, and build a matrix rank[x][y] storing how much x prefers y.

hints.title: Unhappy Condition Check
hints.text: Friend x is unhappy if there exists a friend u whom x prefers over pair_of[x], and u also prefers x over pair_of[u].

hints.title: Iterate Potential Preferred Friends
hints.text: For each person x, iterate through all friends u appearing before pair_of[x] in preferences[x]. If rank[u][x] < rank[u][pair_of[u]], mark x as unhappy.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching through preference arrays repeatedly without rank matrices takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An N x N ranking matrix provides O(1) pairwise preference checks, totaling O(N^2) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate precomputes preference ranks for O(1) comparison in the bipartite dissatisfaction logic.
complexity.notes: Total friends n is always even.
